chapter_28.arabic: اللهم إني أستخيرك بعلمك، وأستقدرك بقدرتك، وأسألك من فضلك العظيم فإنك تقدِرُ ولا أقدِرُ، وتعلم ولا أعلم، وأنت علام الغيوب، اللهم إن كنت تعلم أن هذا الأمر خير لي في ديني ومعاشي وعاقبة أمري أو قال: عاجله وآجله فاقدره لي ويسره لي، ثم بارك لي فيه، وإن كنت تعلم أن هذا الأمر شر لي في ديني ومعاشي وعاقبة أمري أو قال: عاجله وآجله فاصرفه عني واصرفني عنه، واقدر لي الخير حيث كان، ثم ارضني به
chapter_28.transliteration: Allāhumma innī astakhīruka bi 'ilmik, wa astaqdiruka biqudratik, wa as'aluka min faḍlika 'l-'Aẓīm, fa'innaka taqdiru wa lā aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa lā a'lam, wa anta 'allāmu 'l-ghuyūb, Allāhumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hādha 'l-amra khayrun lī fī dīnī wa ma'āshī wa 'āqibati amrī 'aw qāla: 'ājilihi wa 'ājilihi faqdurhu lī wa yassirhu lī, thumma bārik lī fīh, wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hādha 'l-amra sharrun lī fī dīnī wa ma'āshī wa 'āqibati 'amrī 'aw qāla: 'ājilihi wa 'ājilihi faṣrifhu 'annī waṣrifnī 'anh, waqdur liya 'l-khayra ḥaythu kān, thumma arḍinī bih
chapter_28.translation: O Allah, I seek the counsel of Your Knowledge, and I seek the help of Your Omnipotence, and I beseech You for Your Magnificent Grace. Surely, You are Capable and I am not. You know and I know not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter is good for me in my religion and in my life and for my welfare in the life to come - or say: in this life and the afterlife - then ordain it for me and make it easy for me, then bless me in it. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion and in my life and for my welfare in the life to come - or say: in this life and the afterlife - then distance it from me, and distance me from it, and ordain for me what is good wherever it may be, and help me to be content with it.

chapter_29.category_name: When tossing and turning during the night
chapter_29.title: When tossing and turning during the night - Hisn al-Muslim 112
chapter_29.arabic: لا إِلـهَ إِلاّ اللهُ الـواحِدُ القَهّـار رَبُّ السَّـمواتِ وَالأرْضِ وَما بَيْـنَهـما العَزيـزُ الغَـفّار
chapter_29.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāh al-Wāḥidul-Qahhār, Rabbus-samāwāti wa 'l-arḍi wa mā baynahuma al-`Azīzul-Ghaffār.
chapter_29.translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, the One, the Victorious, Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the All-Mighty, the All-Forgiving.
chapter_29.reference: Al-Hakim graded it authentic and Ath-Thahabi agreed 1/540. Also see An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah, and Ibn As-Sunni. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 4/213.

chapter_30.category_name: Upon experiencing unrest, fear, apprehensiveness during sleep
chapter_30.title: Upon experiencing unrest, fear, apprehensiveness during sleep - Hisn al-Muslim 113
chapter_30.arabic: أَعـوذُ بِكَلِمـاتِ اللّهِ التّـامّـاتِ مِن غَضَـبِهِ وَعِـقابِهِ وَشَـرِّ عِبـادِهِ وَمِنْ هَمَـزاتِ الشَّـياطينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضـرون
chapter_30.transliteration: A'ūdhu bikalimāti 'llāhit-tāmmāti min ghaḍabihi wa 'iqābihi wa sharri 'ibādih, wa min hamazātish-shayāṭīni wa an yaḥḍurūn.
chapter_30.translation: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from His anger and His punishment, from the evil of His slaves, and from the taunts of devils and from their presence.
chapter_30.reference: Abu Dawud 4/12. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/171
tags: Upon experiencing unrest, fear, apprehensiveness during sleep

chapter_31.category_name: Upon seeing a good dream or a bad dream
chapter_31.title: When you see a bad dream
chapter_31.arabic: يَنْفُثُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ (ثلاثاً). يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا رَأَى (ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ). لاَ يُحَدِّثْ بِهَا أَحَداً. يَــتَحَوَّلُ عَنْ جَنْبِهِ الَّذِي كَانَ عَلَيْهِ.
chapter_31.transliteration: Yanfuthu 'an yasarihi (thalathan). Yasta'idhu billahi minash-shaytani wa min sharri ma ra'a (thalatha marratin). La yuhaddithu biha ahadan. Yatahawwalu 'an janbih alladhi kana alayh.
chapter_31.translation: Spit to your left (three times). Seek refuge in Allah from the Devil and from the evil of what you have seen (three times). Do not speak about it to anyone. Turn over on your other side.

chapter_31.category_name: Upon seeing a good dream or a bad dream
chapter_31.title: What to do after a bad dream
chapter_31.translation: Get up and pray if you desire to do so.

chapter_32.title: Qunoot supplication during Witr prayer
chapter_32.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ اهْـدِنـي فـيمَنْ هَـدَيْـت، وَعـافِنـي فـيمَنْ عافَـيْت، وَتَوَلَّـني فـيمَنْ تَوَلَّـيْت، وَبارِكْ لـي فـيما أَعْطَـيْت، وَقِـني شَرَّ ما قَضَـيْت، فَإِنَّـكَ تَقْـضي وَلا يُقْـضى عَلَـيْك ، إِنَّـهُ لا يَـذِلُّ مَنْ والَـيْت، [ وَلا يَعِـزُّ مَن عـادَيْت ]، تَبـارَكْـتَ رَبَّـنا وَتَعـالَـيْت
chapter_32.transliteration: Allāhumma'hdinī fī man hadayt, wa 'āfinī fī man 'āfayt, wa tawallanī fī man tawallayt, wa bārik lī fī mā a'atayt, wa qinī sharra mā qaḍayt, fa innaka taqḍī wa lā yuqḍā 'alayk, innahu lā yadhillu man wālayt, [wa lā ya'izzu man 'ādayt], tabārakta Rabbanā wa ta'ālayt.
chapter_32.translation: O Allah, guide me with those whom You have guided, and strengthen me with those whom You have given strength. Take me to Your care with those whom You have taken to Your care. Bless me in what You have given me. Protect me from the evil You have ordained. Surely, You command and are not commanded, and none whom You have committed to Your care shall be humiliated [and none whom You have taken as an enemy shall taste glory]. You are Blessed, Our Lord, and Exalted.
chapter_32.reference: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, An-Nasa'i, At-Tirmidhi, Ahmad, Ad-Darimi, Al-Hakim, and Al-Bayhaqi. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 1/144, Sahih Ibn Majah 1/194, and 'Irwa'ul-Ghalil 2/172

chapter_32.title: Seeking refuge during Qunoot
chapter_32.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّـي أَعـوذُ بِرِضـاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِـك، وَبِمُعـافاتِـكَ مِنْ عُقوبَـتِك، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْـك، لا أُحْصـي ثَنـاءً عَلَـيْك، أَنْـتَ كَمـا أَثْنَـيْتَ عَلـى نَفْسـِك
chapter_32.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu biriḍāka min sakhaṭik, wa bimu'āfātika min 'uqūbatik, wa a'ūdhu bika mink, lā uḥṣī thanā'an 'alayk, Anta kamā athnayta 'alā nafsik.
chapter_32.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with Your Pleasure from Your anger. I seek refuge in Your forgiveness from Your punishment. I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot count Your praises, You are as You have praised Yourself.
chapter_32.reference: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, An-Nasa'i, At-Tirmidhi, Ahmad. See Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/180, Sahih Ibn Majah 1/194, and 'Irwa'ul-Ghalil 2/175

chapter_32.title: Worship and praise in Qunoot
chapter_32.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِيّـاكَ نعْـبُدْ، وَلَـكَ نُصَلّـي وَنَسْـجُد، وَإِلَـيْكَ نَسْـعى وَنَحْـفِد، نَـرْجو رَحْمَـتَك، وَنَخْشـى عَـذابَك، إِنَّ عَـذابَكَ بالكـافرين ملْحَـق. اللّهُـمَّ إِنّا نَسْتَعـينُكَ وَنَسْتَـغْفِرُك، وَنُثْـنـي عَلَـيْك الخَـيْرَ، وَلا نَكْـفُرُك، وَنُـؤْمِنُ بِك، وَنَخْـضَعُ لَكَ وَنَخْـلَعُ مَنْ يَكْـفرُك
chapter_32.transliteration: Allāhumma iyyāka na'bud, wa laka nuṣallī wa nasjud, wa ilayka nas'ā wa naḥfid, narjū raḥmatak, wa nakhshā 'adhābak, inna 'adhābaka bilkāfirīna mulḥaq. Allāhumma innā nasta'īnuk, wa nastaghfiruk, wa nuthnī 'alaykal-khayr, wa lā nakfuruk, wa nu'minu bik, wa nakhḍa'u lak, wa nakhla'u man yakfuruk.
chapter_32.translation: O Allah, You alone do we worship, and to You we pray and bow down prostrate. To You we hasten to worship and to serve. Our hope is for Your mercy, and we fear Your punishment. Surely, Your punishment of the disbelievers is at hand. O Allah, we seek Your help and Your forgiveness, and we praise You beneficently. We do not deny You and we believe in You. We surrender to You and renounce whoever disbelieves in You.
chapter_32.reference: Al-Bayhaqi graded its chain authentic in As-Sunan Al-Kubra. Al-Albani said in 'Irwa'ul-Ghalil 2/170 that its chain is authentic as a statement of 'Umar

chapter_33.category_name: Immediately After Salam Of The Witr Prayer
chapter_33.title: Glorification and praise after Witr prayer salam
chapter_33.arabic: سبحان الملك القدوس" ثلاث مرات والثالثة يجهر بها ويمد بها صوته "ربِّ الملائكةِ والرّوح
chapter_33.transliteration: Subḥāna 'l-Maliki 'l-Quddūs. [Recite three times, and raise and extend the voice on the third time and say...] Rabbi 'l-Malā'ikati war-rūh.
chapter_33.translation: Glory is to the King, the Holy. [Recite three times in Arabic, and raise and extend the voice on the third time and say...] Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
chapter_33.reference: An-Nasa'i 3/244, Ad-Daraqutni and others. The final addition is from Ad-Daraqutni's version 2/ 31 and its chain of narration is authentic. See the checking of Zadul-Ma'ad by Shu'aib Al-Arna'ut and 'Abdul-Qadir Al-Arna'ut 1/337.

chapter_34.title: For anxiety and sorrow - Hisn al-Muslim 120
chapter_34.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّي عَبْـدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْـدِكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِـكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَـدِكَ مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤكَ أَسْأَلُـكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّـيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ أِوْ أَنْزَلْتَـهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ أَوْ عَلَّمْـتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِـكَ أَوِ اسْتَـأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْـبِ عِنْـدَكَ أَنْ تَجْـعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيـعَ قَلْبِـي وَنورَ صَـدْرِي وجَلَاءَ حُـزْنِي وذَهَابَ هَمِّـي
chapter_34.transliteration: Allāhumma innī `abduk, ibnu `abdik, ibnu amatik, nāsiyatī biyadik, māḍin fiyya ḥukmuk, `adlun fiyya qaḍā'uk, as'aluka bikullis'min huwa lak, sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fī kitābik, aw `allamtahu aḥadan min khalqik, aw'ista'tharta bihi fī `ilmil-ghaybi `indak, an taj`ala 'l-Qur'āna rabī`a qalbī, wa nūra ṣadrī, wa jalā'a ḥuznī, wa dhahāba hammī.
chapter_34.translation: O Allah, I am Your slave, and the son of Your male slave, and the son of your female slave. My forehead is in Your Hand (i.e. you have control over me). Your Judgment upon me is assured, and Your Decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every Name that You have named Yourself with, revealed in Your Book, taught any one of Your creation, or kept unto Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen that is with You, to make the Qur'an the spring of my heart, and the light of my chest, the banisher of my sadness, and the reliever of my distress.
chapter_34.reference: Ahmad 1/391, and Al-Albani graded it authentic.

chapter_34.title: For anxiety and sorrow - Hisn al-Muslim 121
chapter_34.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّي أَعْوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الهَـمِّ وَ الْحُـزْنِ، والعًجْـزِ والكَسَلِ والبُخْـلِ والجُـبْنِ، وضَلْـعِ الـدَّيْنِ وغَلَبَـةِ الرِّجال
chapter_34.transliteration: Allāhumma 'innī 'a`ūdhu bika mina 'l-ḥammi wa 'l-ḥuzn, wa 'l-`ajzi wa 'l-kasal, wa 'l-bukhli wa 'l-jubn, wa ḍala`id-dayn, wa ghalabatir-rijāl.
chapter_34.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men (i.e. others).

chapter_35.title: For one in distress - Hisn al-Muslim 122
chapter_35.arabic: لَا إلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظـيمُ الْحَلِـيمْ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ العَـرْشِ العَظِيـمِ، لَا إِلَـهَ إِلَّا اللَّهْ رَبُّ السَّمَـوّاتِ ورّبُّ الأَرْضِ ورَبُّ العَرْشِ الكَـريم
chapter_35.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāh al-`Aẓīmul-Ḥalīm, lā ilāha illallāh Rabbu 'l-`Arshi 'l-'Aẓīm, lā ilāha illallāh Rabbus-samāwāti wa Rabbu 'l-arḍ wa Rabbu 'l-`Arshi 'l-Karīm.
chapter_35.translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

chapter_35.title: For one in distress - Hisn al-Muslim 123
chapter_35.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ رَحْمَتَـكَ أَرْجـو فَلا تَكِلـني إِلى نَفْـسي طَـرْفَةَ عَـيْن، وَأَصْلِـحْ لي شَأْنـي كُلَّـه لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أنْـت
chapter_35.transliteration: Allāhumma raḥmataka arjū falā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata `ayn, wa aṣliḥ lī sha'nī kullah, lā ilāha illā ant.
chapter_35.translation: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment). Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You.
chapter_35.reference: Abu Dawud 4/324, Ahmad 5/42. Al-Albani graded it as good in Sahih Abu Dawud 3/959.

chapter_35.title: For one in distress - Hisn al-Muslim 124
chapter_35.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أنْـت سُـبْحانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْـتُ مِنَ الظّـالِميـن
chapter_35.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn.
chapter_35.translation: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrongdoers.
chapter_35.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/529. Al-Hakim declared it authentic and Ath-Thahabi agreed with him 1/505. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/168.

chapter_35.title: For one in distress - Hisn al-Muslim 125
chapter_35.arabic: اللهُ اللهُ رَبِّي لا أُشْـرِكُ بِهِ شَيْـئاً
chapter_35.transliteration: Allāh, Allāhu Rabbī lā ushriku bihi shay'a.
chapter_35.translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him.
chapter_35.reference: Abu Dawud 2/87. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Mdjah 2/335.

chapter_36.title: Dua during Rukoo
chapter_36.transliteration: Allāhumma laka raka'tu, wa bika 'āmantu, wa laka 'aslamtu khasha'a laka sam'ee wa baṣarī, wa mukhkhī, wa 'aẓmī, wa 'aṣabī, wa mastaqalla bihi qadamī.
chapter_36.translation: O Allah, to You I bow (in prayer) and in You I believe and to You I have submitted. Before You my hearing is humbled, and my sight, and my mind, my bones, my nerves and what my feet have mounted upon (for travel).
chapter_36.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ لَكَ رَكَـعْتُ وَبِكَ آمَـنْت، ولَكَ أَسْلَـمْت ، خَشَـعَ لَكَ سَمْـعي، وَبَصَـري ، وَمُخِّـي، وَعَظْمـي، وَعَصَـبي ، وَما استَقَـلَّ بِهِ قَدَمي

chapter_37.category_name: For one afraid of the ruler's injustice
chapter_37.title: For one afraid of the ruler's injustice - Hisn al-Muslim 129
chapter_37.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلاَئِقِكَ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
chapter_37.transliteration: Allāhumma Rabbas-samāwātis-sab', wa Rabba 'l-'Arshi 'l-'Aẓīm, kun lī jāran min [here you mention the person's name], wa aḥzābihi min khalā'iqik, an yafruṭa 'alayya aḥadun minhum aw yaṭghā, 'azza jāruk, wa jalla thanā'uk, wa lā ilāha illā ant.
chapter_37.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is Your patronage, and glorious are Your praises. There is none worthy of worship but You.
chapter_37.reference: Al-Bukhari, Al-'Adab Al-Mufrad (no. 707). Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Al-'Adab Al-Mufrad (no. 545).

chapter_37.category_name: For one afraid of the ruler's injustice
chapter_37.title: For one afraid of the ruler's injustice - Hisn al-Muslim 130
chapter_37.arabic: الله أكبر، الله أعز من خلقه جميعاً ، الله أعز مما أخاف وأحذر ، أعوذ بالله الذي لا إله إلا هو ، الممسك السموات السبع أن يقعن على الأرض إلا بإذنه ، من شر عبدك فلان ، وجنوده وأتباعه وأشياعه ، من الجن والأنس ، اللهم كن لي جاراً من شرهم ، جل ثناؤك وعز جارك ، وتبارك اسمك ، ولا إله غيرك
chapter_37.transliteration: Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu a'azzu min khalqihi jamī'a, Allāhu a'azzu mimmā akhāfu wa aḥdhar, a'ūdhu billāhi 'l-ladhī lā ilāha illā hū, almumsikis-samāwātis-sab'i an yaqa'na 'ala 'l-arḍi illā bi idhnih, min sharri 'abdika [name of the person], wa junūdihi wa atbā'ihi wa ashyā'ih, mina 'l-jinni wa 'l-ins, Allāhumma kun lī jāran min sharrihim, jalla thanā'uk, wa 'azza jāruk, wa tabāraka-smuk, wa lā ilāha ghayruk.
chapter_37.translation: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what I fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. [I seek refuge in You Allah] from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers, and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious are Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You.

chapter_38.title: Dua Against Enemies
chapter_38.transliteration: Allāhumma munzila 'l-kitāb, sarī'a 'l-ḥisāb, ihzimi 'l-aḥzāb, Allāhumma-hzimhum wa zalzilhum.
chapter_38.translation: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift to account, defeat the groups (of disbelievers). O Allah, defeat them and shake them.
chapter_38.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَاب سَرِيعَ الْحِسَاب اهْزِم الأَحْزَاب اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَ زَلْزِلْهُم

chapter_39.category_name: When being afraid of a group of people
chapter_39.title: When being afraid of a group of people - Hisn al-Muslim 132
chapter_39.translation: O Allah, suffice (i.e. protect) me against them however You wish.

chapter_40.dua_text_english: I seek refuge in Allah. (Then you should desist from doing what you are in doubt about.)
chapter_40.dua_text_arabic:
يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ.
يَنْتَهِي عَمَّا شك فِيهِ.

chapter_40.dua_text_english: I believe in Allah and His Messengers.
He is the First and the Last, the Most High and the Most Near. And He is the Knower of all things. (Recite the Ayat in Arabic)
chapter_40.dua_text_transliteration: Huwa 'l-Awwalu wa 'l-Ākhir, waẓ-Ẓāhiru wal-Bāṭin, wa huwa bikulli shay'in 'Alīm
chapter_40.dua_text_arabic: هُوَ الأوَّلُ، وَالآخِـرُ، وَالظّـاهِـرُ، وَالْبـاطِـنُ، وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عَلـيم
chapter_40.reference: Al-Hadid 57:3, Abu Dawud 4/329. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 3/962

chapter_41.title: Dua for sufficiency and independence - Hisn al-Muslim 136
chapter_41.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ اكْفِـني بِحَلالِـكَ عَنْ حَـرامِـك، وَأَغْنِـني بِفَضْـلِكَ عَمَّـنْ سِـواك
chapter_41.transliteration: Allāhummak-finī biḥalālika `an ḥarāmik, wa 'aghninī bi faḍlika `amman siwāk.
chapter_41.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You.
chapter_41.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/560. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/180.

chapter_41.title: Seeking refuge from worry and debt - Hisn al-Muslim 137
chapter_41.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
chapter_41.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a`ūdhu bika mina 'l-ḥammi wa 'l-ḥazan, wa 'l-`ajzi wa 'l-kasal, wa 'l-bukhli wa 'l-jubn, wa ḍala`id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijāl.
chapter_41.translation: O Allah! I seek refuge with You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from being heavily in debt and from being overpowered by (other) men.

chapter_42.title: Refuge from Satan during prayer or recitation
chapter_42.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، وَاتْفُلْ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ (ثلاثاً)
chapter_42.transliteration: A'ūdhu billāhi minash-shayṭānir-rajīm. (Say:) I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast (then blow with a little spittle to your left). (Do this three times reciting in Arabic.)
chapter_42.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast. (Then blow with a little spittle to your left. Do this three times.)

chapter_43.category_name: For one whose affairs have become difficult
chapter_43.title: For one whose affairs have become difficult - Hisn al-Muslim 139
chapter_43.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً
chapter_43.transliteration: Allāhumma lā saḥla illā ma ja'altahu saḥla wa anta taj'alu 'l-ḥazna idhā shi'ta saḥla.
chapter_43.translation: O Allah, there is no ease other than what You make easy. If You please You ease sorrow.
chapter_43.reference: Ibn Hibban in his Sahih (no. 2427), and Ibn As-Sunni (no. 351). Al-Hafidh (Ibn Hajar) said that this Hadith is authentic. It was also declared authentic by 'Abdul-Qadir Al-Arna'ut in his checking of An-Nawawi's Kitabul-Athkarp. 106.

chapter_44.dua_text_english: There is not any slave of Allah who commits a sin, then he perfects his purification and stands to pray two Rak'ahs of prayer, then seeks Allah's forgiveness, except that Allah will forgive him.
chapter_44.dua_text_transliteration: Mā min 'abdin yudhnib dhanbān fa-yuḥsin aṭ-ṭuhūr, thumma yaqūm fa-yuṣallī rak'atayn, thumma yastaghfir Allāh illā ghafara Allāhu lah.
chapter_44.dua_text_arabic: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذنِبُ ذَنْباً فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ إِلاَّ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ
chapter_44.reference: Abu Dawud 2/86, At-Tirmidhi 2/257. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/283.

chapter_45.category_name: For expelling the devil and his whisperings
chapter_45.title: Seeking refuge with Allah from Satan
chapter_45.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.
chapter_45.reference: Abu Dawud 1/206, At-Tirmidhi. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 1/77, and Surat Al-Mu'minun, 23:98-9.

chapter_45.category_name: For expelling the devil and his whisperings
chapter_45.title: The call to prayer protects from Satan
chapter_45.translation: The call to prayer - Athan. The Devil is expelled through the call to prayer.

chapter_45.category_name: For expelling the devil and his whisperings
chapter_45.title: Remembrance and Quran recitation expel Satan
chapter_45.transliteration: Al-'Adhkār wa qirā'atu al-Qur'ān (Remembrance and recitation of the Quran)
chapter_45.translation: Saying words of Allah's remembrance (Thikr) and recitation of the Qur'an. Do not turn your homes into graveyards, surely the Devil flees from the house in which Surat Al-Baqarah is read. The Devil is also driven out by the invocations for morning and evening, those that are said before sleeping and upon waking up, those for entering and leaving the house, including those for entering and leaving the mosque, and by many other authentic invocations taught to us by the Prophet (ﷺ) such as the reading of 'Ayatul-Kursi, (Al-Baqarah 2:255), and the last two 'Ayat of Surat Al-Baqarah before going to sleep. Whoever says: 'There is none worthy of worship but Allah alone, Who has no partner, His is the dominion and His is the praise, and he is Able to do all things,' one hundred times, it will be a protection for him from the Devil throughout the day.
chapter_45.reference: Muslim 1/539. See also references for morning and evening dhikr, bedtime supplications, and other related chapters.

chapter_46.category_name: When stricken with a mishap or overtaken by an affair
chapter_46.title: When stricken with a mishap or overtaken by an affair - Hisn al-Muslim 144
chapter_46.translation: It is the Decree of Allah and He does whatever He wills.
tags: When stricken with a mishap or overtaken by an affair

chapter_47.dua_text_english: May Allah bless you with His gift to you, and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness.
chapter_47.dua_text_transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka fi 'l-mawhūbi lak, wa shakarta 'l-wāhib, wa balagha ashuddah, wa ruziqta birrah.
chapter_47.dua_text_arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ
chapter_47.reference: An-Nawawi, Kitdbul-'Athkarp. 349, and Sahihul-'Athkar 2/713 by Saleem Al-Hilali
chapter_47.occasion: Congratulating someone on the birth of a child

chapter_47.dua_text_english: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly
chapter_47.dua_text_transliteration: Bārakallahu laka wa bāraka `alayk, wa jazākallāhu khayra, wa razaqakallāhu mithlah, wa ajzala thawābak.
chapter_47.dua_text_arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ
chapter_47.reference: An-Nawawi, Kitdbul-'Athkarp. 349, and Sahihul-'Athkar 2/713 by Saleem Al-Hilali
chapter_47.occasion: Reply of the person being congratulated

chapter_48.title: Seeking Allah's protection for children
chapter_48.arabic: أَعيذُكُما بِكَلِمات اللهِ التَّامَّة ، مِن كُلِّ شَيطانٍ وَهَامَّة ، وَمِن كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّة
chapter_48.transliteration: U'īthukumā bikalimāti 'llāhit-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmah, wa min kulli 'aynin lāmmah
chapter_48.translation: I seek protection for you in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every beast, and from every envious blameworthy eye.
chapter_48.notes: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to seek Allah's protection for Al-Hasan and Al-Husain by saying this dua.

chapter_49.title: Do not worry, it will be a purification
chapter_49.arabic: لا بأْسَ طَهـورٌ إِنْ شـاءَ الله
chapter_49.transliteration: Lā ba'sa ṭahūrun in shā Allāh.
chapter_49.translation: Do not worry, it will be a purification (for you), Allah willing.
chapter_49.notes: Said to a sick person to comfort and encourage them.

chapter_49.title: I ask Almighty Allah to make you well
chapter_49.arabic: أَسْـأَلُ اللهَ العَـظيـم، رَبَّ العَـرْشِ العَـظيـم أَنْ يَشْفـيك . (سبع مرات)
chapter_49.translation: I ask Almighty Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to make you well.
chapter_49.reference: At-Tirmidhi, Abu Dawud. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/210 and Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 5/180
chapter_49.notes: Recite seven times in Arabic. A powerful dua for healing the sick.

chapter_50.title: Excellence of visiting the sick
chapter_50.transliteration: When a man goes to visit his sick Muslim brother, he walks along a path of Paradise until he sits, and when he sits he is cloaked in mercy. If he comes in the morning, seventy thousand angels pray for him until evening, and if he comes in the evening, seventy thousand angels pray for him until morning.
chapter_50.text_arabic: قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (إِذَا عَادَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ مَشَى فِي خِرَافَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَجْلِسَ، فَإِذَا جَلَسَ غَمَرَتْهُ الرَّحْمَةُ، فَإِنْ كَانَ غُدْوَةً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مَسَاءً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ)
chapter_50.reference: Not a dua but a hadith describing the virtue of visiting the sick

chapter_51.category_name: When the sick have renounced all hope of life
chapter_51.title: Supplication for forgiveness and mercy at the time of death
chapter_51.arabic: أللّهُـمَّ اغْفِـرْ لي وَارْحَمْـني وَأَلْحِقْـني بِالرَّفـيقِ الأّعْلـى
chapter_51.transliteration: Allāhumma'ghfir lī warḥamnī wa alḥiqnī bir-rafīqi 'l-'A`alā.
chapter_51.translation: O Allah, forgive me and have mercy upon me, and join me with the highest companions (in Paradise).

chapter_51.category_name: When the sick have renounced all hope of life
chapter_51.title: The Prophet's supplication at the time of death
chapter_51.arabic: جعل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عند موته يدخل يديه في الماء فيمسح بهما وجههُ ويقول : لا إله إلا الله إن للموت لسكرات
chapter_51.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāh inna li 'lmawti la'sakarāt.
chapter_51.translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, surely death has agonies.

chapter_51.category_name: When the sick have renounced all hope of life
chapter_51.title: Comprehensive declaration of Allah's oneness and might
chapter_51.arabic: لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ وَاللّهُ أَكْبَـر، لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ وحْـدَهُ، لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ وحْـدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ لهُ المُلكُ ولهُ الحَمْد، لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ وَلا حَـوْلَ وَلا قُـوَّةَ إِلاّ بِالله
chapter_51.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāh wallāhu Akbar, lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdah, lā ilāha illallāh waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lā ilāha illallāh lahu 'l-mulku wa lahu 'l-ḥamd, lā ilāha illallāh wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.
chapter_51.translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Allah is the Most Great. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, His is the dominion and His is the praise. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, there is no power and no might but by Allah.
chapter_51.reference: At-Tirmidhi and Ibn Majah. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/152 and Sahih Ibn Majah 2/317

chapter_52.title: The Tashahhud - Hisn al-Muslim 52
chapter_52.arabic: التَّحِيّـاتُ للهِ وَالصَّلَـواتُ والطَّيِّـبات ، السَّلامُ عَلَيـكَ أَيُّهـا النَّبِـيُّ وَرَحْمَـةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكـاتُه ، السَّلامُ عَلَيْـناوَعَلـى عِبـادِ للهِ الصَّـالِحـين . أَشْـهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلـهَ إِلاّ الله ، وَأَشْـهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمّـداً عَبْـدُهُ وَرَسـولُه
chapter_52.transliteration: Attaḥiyyātu lillāhi waṣṣalawātu, waṭṭayyibāt, assalāmu `alayka 'ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa raḥmatullāhi wa barakātuh, assalāmu `alaynā wa `alā 'ibādillāhiṣ-ṣāliḥīn. 'Ash-hadu 'an lā 'ilāha 'illallāh wa 'ash-hadu 'anna Muḥammadan `abduhu wa rasūluh.
chapter_52.translation: All greetings of humility are for Allah, and all prayers and goodness. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous slaves of Allah. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger.
chapter_52.reference: Al-Bukhari, Muslim 1/301. See also Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 1/13

chapter_53.dua_english: Innā lillāhi wa innā ilayhi rāji`ūn, Allāhumma-jurni fī muṣībatī wa 'khluf lī khayran minhā.
chapter_53.dua_transliteration: Innā lillāhi wa innā ilayhi rāji`ūn, Allāhumma-jurni fī muṣībatī wa 'khluf lī khayran minhā.
chapter_53.dua_arabic: إِنّا للهِ وَإِنَا إِلَـيْهِ راجِعـون ، اللهُـمِّ اْجُـرْني في مُصـيبَتي، وَاخْلُـفْ لي خَيْـراً مِنْـها
chapter_53.translation: We are from Allah and unto Him we return. O Allah take me out of my plight and bring to me after it something better.

chapter_54.category_name: When closing the eyes of the deceased
chapter_54.title: When closing the eyes of the deceased - Hisn al-Muslim 155
chapter_54.arabic: اللهُـمِّ اغْفِـرْ لِـفلان (باسـمه) وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَـهُ في المَهْـدِييـن ، وَاخْـلُفْـهُ في عَقِـبِهِ في الغابِـرين، وَاغْفِـرْ لَنـا وَلَـهُ يا رَبَّ العـالَمـين، وَافْسَـحْ لَهُ في قَبْـرِهِ وَنَـوِّرْ لَهُ فيه
chapter_54.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li (name of the person) warfa' darajatahu fil-mahdiyyin, wakhlufhu fi 'aqibihi fil-ghabirin, waghfir-lana wa lahu ya Rabbal-'alamin, wafsah lahu fi qabrihi wa nawwir lahu fih.
chapter_54.translation: O Allah, forgive [name of the person] and elevate his station among those who are guided. Send him along the path of those who came before, and forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds. Enlarge for him his grave, and shed light upon him in it.
tags: When closing the eyes of the deceased

chapter_55.dua_arabic: اللهُـمِّ اغْفِـرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْـه ، وَعافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْـه ، وَأَكْـرِمْ نُزُلَـه ، وَوَسِّـعْ مُدْخَـلَه ، وَاغْسِلْـهُ بِالْمـاءِ وَالثَّـلْجِ وَالْبَـرَدْ ، وَنَقِّـهِ مِنَ الْخطـايا كَما نَـقّيْتَ الـثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَـضَ مِنَ الدَّنَـسْ ، وَأَبْـدِلْهُ داراً خَـيْراً مِنْ دارِه ، وَأَهْلاً خَـيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِـه ، وَزَوْجَـاً خَـيْراً مِنْ زَوْجِه ، وَأَدْخِـلْهُ الْجَـنَّة ، وَأَعِـذْهُ مِنْ عَذابِ القَـبْر [وَعَذابِ النّـار]
chapter_55.dua_transliteration: Allāhumma'ghfir lahu warḥamh, wa 'āfihi, wa'fu 'anh, wa akrim nuzulah, wa wassi' mudkhalah, wagh'silhu bi 'lmā'i wath-thalji walbarad, wa naqqihi mina 'l-khaṭāyā kamā naqqaytath-thawba 'l-abyaḍa minad-danas, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārih, wa ahlan khayran min ahlih, wa zawjan khayran min zawjih, wa adkhilhu 'l-jannah, wa a'idhhu min 'adhābi 'l-qabri [wa 'adhābin-nār].
chapter_55.dua_translation: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, and give him strength and pardon him. Be generous to him, and cause his entrance to be wide, and wash him with water and snow and hail. Cleanse him of his transgressions as white cloth is cleansed of stains. Give him an abode better than his home, and a family better than his family, and a wife better than his wife. Take him into Paradise, and protect him from the punishment of the grave [and from the punishment of Hell-fire].

chapter_55.dua_arabic: اللهُـمِّ اغْفِـرْ لِحَيِّـنا وَمَيِّتِـنا، وَشـاهِدِنا وَغائِبِـنا ، وَصَغيـرِنا وَكَبيـرِنا ، وَذَكَـرِنا وَأُنْثـانا . اللهُـمِّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْـتَهُ مِنّا فَأَحْيِـهِ عَلى الإِسْلام ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّـيْتَهُ مِنّا فَتَوَفَّـهُ عَلى الإِيـمان ، اللهُـمِّ لا تَحْـرِمْنـا أَجْـرَه ، وَلا تُضِـلَّنا بَعْـدَه
chapter_55.dua_transliteration: Allāhumma'ghfir liḥayyinā, wa mayyitinā, wa shāhidinā, wa ghā'ibinā, wa ṣaghīrinā wa kabīrinā, wa dhakarinā wa unthānā. Allāhumma man aḥyaytahu minnā fa aḥyihi 'ala 'l-Islām, wa man tawaffaytahu minnā fatawaffahu 'alal-īmān, Allāhumma lā taḥrimnā ajrah wa lā tuḍillanā ba'dah.
chapter_55.dua_translation: O Allah forgive our living and our dead, those who are with us and those who are absent, our young and our old, our menfolk and our womenfolk. O Allah, whomever you give life from among us give him life in Islam, and whomever you take away from us take him away in Faith. O Allah, do not forbid us their reward and do not send us astray after them.

chapter_55.dua_arabic: اللهُـمِّ إِنَّ فُلانَ بْنَ فُلانٍ في ذِمَّـتِك ، وَحَبْـلِ جِـوارِك ، فَقِـهِ مِنْ فِتْـنَةِ الْقَـبْرِ وَعَذابِ النّـار ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفـاءِ وَالْـحَقِّ ، فَاغْفِـرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْـهُ ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَـفورُ الـرَّحيم
chapter_55.dua_transliteration: Allāhumma inna [name the person] fī dhimmatik, wa ḥabli jiwārik, faqihi min fitnati 'l-qabri wa 'adhābin-nār, wa anta ahlu 'l-wafā'i wa 'l-ḥaqq. Faghfir lahu warḥamh innaka anta 'l-Ghafūrur-Raḥīm.
chapter_55.dua_translation: O Allah, surely [name the person] is under Your protection, and in the rope of Your security, so save him from the trial of the grave and from the punishment of the Fire. You fulfill promises and grant rights, so forgive him and have mercy on him. Surely You are Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
chapter_55.note: The person's name should be mentioned in place of 'fūlān' (the person's placeholder)

chapter_55.dua_arabic: اللهُـمِّ عَبْـدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَـتِك، احْتـاجَ إِلى رَحْمَـتِك، وَأَنْتَ غَنِـيٌّ عَنْ عَذابِـه، إِنْ كانَ مُحْـسِناً فَزِدْ في حَسَـناتِه، وَإِنْ كانَ مُسـيئاً فَتَـجاوَزْ عَنْـه
chapter_55.dua_transliteration: Allāhumma 'abduka wabnu 'amatik iḥtāja ilā raḥmatik, wa anta ghaniyyun 'an 'adhābih, in kāna muḥsinan fazid fī ḥasanātih, wa in kāna musī'an fatajāwaz 'anh.
chapter_55.dua_translation: O Allah, Your male slave and the child of Your female slave is in need of Your mercy, and You are not in need of his torment. If he was pious then increase his rewards and if he was a transgressor then pardon him.

chapter_56.category_name: When the deceased is a child, during the funeral prayer
chapter_56.title: Supplication for a deceased child during the funeral prayer
chapter_56.translation: O Allah, protect him from the torment of the grave.
chapter_56.extended_translation: It is also good to say: O Allah, make him a precursor, a forerunner and a treasure for his parents and an answered intercessor. O Allah, make him weigh heavily in their scales (of good) and magnify their reward. Make him join the righteous of the believers. Place him in the care of Ibrahim. Save him by Your mercy from the torment of Hell. Give him a home better than his home, and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive those who have gone (i.e. passed away) before us, our children lost (by death), and those who have preceded us in Faith.

chapter_56.category_name: When the deceased is a child, during the funeral prayer
chapter_56.title: Alternative supplication for a deceased child
chapter_56.arabic: اللهُـمِّ اجْعَلْـهُ لَنا فَرَطـاً، وَسَلَـفاً وَأَجْـراً
chapter_56.transliteration: Allāhumma'j'alhu lanā faraṭan, wa salafan, wa ajra
chapter_56.translation: O Allah, make him for us a precursor, a forerunner and a cause of reward.
chapter_56.notes: Al-Hasan (Al-Basri) used to recite Surat Al-Fatihah for a child's funeral and then say this supplication.

chapter_57.title: Condolence - Hisn al-Muslim 162
chapter_57.arabic: إن لله ما أخذ وله ما أعطى . وكل شيء عنده بأجل مُسمى ... فلتصبر ولتحتسب
chapter_57.transliteration: Inna lillāhi mā akhadh, wa lahu mā a`tā, wa kullu shay'in `indahu bi ajalin musammā . . . faltaṣbir wa 'l-taḥtasib.
chapter_57.translation: Surely, Allah takes what is His, and what He gives is His, and to all things He has appointed a time... so have patience and be rewarded.

chapter_57.title: Condolence - Alternative - Hisn al-Muslim 162
chapter_57.arabic: أعظم الله أجرك ، وأحسن عزاءك وغفر لميتك
chapter_57.transliteration: A`ẓamallāhu ajrak, wa 'aḥsana `azā'ak, wa ghafara limayyitik.
chapter_57.translation: May Allah magnify your reward, and make perfect your bereavement, and forgive your departed.

chapter_58.category_name: Placing the deceased in the grave
chapter_58.title: Placing the deceased in the grave - Hisn al-Muslim 163
chapter_58.arabic: بِسْـمِ اللهِ وَعَلـى سُـنَّةِ رَسـولِ الله
chapter_58.translation: With the Name of Allah, and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.
chapter_58.reference: Abu Dawud 3/314 with an authentic chain. Ahmad also recorded it with the wording: With the Name of Allah, and according to the religion of the Messenger of Allah. Its chain is also authentic.
tags: Placing the deceased in the grave

chapter_59.english: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him.
chapter_59.explanation: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to stop after burying the dead and say to the people: "Ask Allah to forgive your brother and pray for him to be strengthened, for indeed he is now being questioned."
chapter_59.reference: Abu Dawud 3/315, and Al-Hakim 1/370 who graded it authentic and Ath-Thahabi agreed.

chapter_60.title: Visiting the graves - Hisn al-Muslim 60
chapter_60.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَـيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيارِ مِنَ المؤْمِنيـنَ وَالْمُسْلِمين، وَإِنّا إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ بِكُـمْ لاحِقـون، نَسْـاَلُ اللهَ لنـا وَلَكُـمْ العـافِيَة
chapter_60.transliteration: Assalāmu `alaykum ahlad-diyāri minal-mu'minīna wa 'l-muslimīn, wa innā in shā' Allāhu bikum lāḥiqūn nas'alullāha lanā wa lakumul-`āfiyah.
chapter_60.translation: Peace be upon you, people of this abode, from among the believers and those who are Muslims, and we, by the Will of Allah, shall be joining you. [May Allah have mercy on the first of us and the last of us] I ask Allah to grant us and you well-being.
chapter_60.reference: Muslim 2/671, Ibn Majah 1/494, the portion brackets is from Muslim 2/671.

chapter_61.arabic: أعيذكما بكلمات الله التامة ، من كل شيطان وهامة ، ومن كل عينِ لامة
chapter_61.transliteration: U'īthukumā bikalimāti 'llāhit-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmah, wa min kulli 'aynin lāmmah
chapter_61.translation: I seek protection for you in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every beast, and from every envious blameworthy eye.
chapter_61.context: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to seek Allah's protection for Al-Hasan and Al-Husain by saying:

chapter_62.title: Upon hearing thunder - Hisn al-Muslim 168
chapter_62.arabic: سُبْـحانَ الّذي يُسَبِّـحُ الـرَّعْدُ بِحَمْـدِهِ، وَالملائِكـةُ مِنْ خيـفَته
chapter_62.transliteration: Subḥāna 'l-ladhī yusabbiḥur-ra`du bi ḥamdihi wa 'l-malā'ikatu min khīfatih.
chapter_62.translation: Glory is to Him Whom thunder and angels glorify due to fear of Him.
chapter_62.reference: Al-Muwatta' 2/992. It was graded authentic by Al-Albani as a statement of Abdullah bin Zubayr only. Whenever Abdullah bin Zubair (RA) would hear thunder, he would abandon all conversation and say this supplication.

chapter_63.title: For rain - Hisn al-Muslim 169
chapter_63.arabic: اللّهُمَّ اسْقِـنا غَيْـثاً مُغيـثاً مَريئاً مُريـعاً، نافِعـاً غَيْـرَ ضار، عاجِـلاً غَـيْرَ آجِل
chapter_63.transliteration: Allāhumma 'asqinā ghaythan mughīthan marī'an murī`a, nāfi`an ghayra ḍārr, `ājilan ghayra ājil.
chapter_63.translation: O Allah, shower upon us abundant rain, beneficial not harmful, swiftly and not delayed.
chapter_63.reference: Abu Dawud 1/303. See also Al-Albani Sahih Abu Dawud 1/216.

chapter_63.title: For rain - Hisn al-Muslim 170
chapter_63.arabic: اللّهُمَّ أغِثْنـا، اللّهُمَّ أغِثْنـا، اللّهُمَّ أغِثْنـا
chapter_63.transliteration: Allāhumma aghithnā, Allāhumma aghithnā, Allāhumma aghithnā.
chapter_63.translation: O Allah, send us rain. O Allah, send us rain. O Allah, send us rain.

chapter_63.title: For rain - Hisn al-Muslim 171
chapter_63.arabic: اللّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبادَكَ وَبَهـائِمَك، وَانْشُـرْ رَحْمَـتَكَ وَأَحْيِي بَلَـدَكَ المَيِّـت
chapter_63.transliteration: Allāhumma'sqi `ibādaka wa bahā'imak, wanshur raḥmatak, wa aḥyi baladaka 'l-mayyit.
chapter_63.translation: O Allah, give water to Your slaves, and Your livestock, and spread Your mercy, and revive Your dead land.
chapter_63.reference: Abu Dawud 1/305. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/218.

chapter_65.translation: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.

chapter_66.title: Astaghfirullāh (three times) - The Forgiveness and Peace Invocation
chapter_66.transliteration: Astaghfirullāh (three times) Allāhumma antas-salām, wa minkas-salām, tabārakta yā dhal-Jalāli wal-'Ikrām.
chapter_66.translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah (three times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Owner of majesty and honor.
chapter_66.arabic: أَسْـتَغْفِرُ الله (ثَلاثاً) اللّهُـمَّ أَنْـتَ السَّلامُ وَمِـنْكَ السَّلام تَبارَكْتَ يا ذا الجَـلالِ وَالإِكْـرام

chapter_67.title: Upon sighting the crescent moon
chapter_67.arabic: اللهُ أَكْـبَر، اللّهُمَّ أَهِلَّـهُ عَلَيْـنا بِالأمْـنِ وَالإيمـان، والسَّلامَـةِ والإسْلام، وَالتَّـوْفيـقِ لِما تُحِـبُّ رَبَّنـا وَتَـرْضـى، رَبُّنـا وَرَبُّكَ الله
chapter_67.transliteration: Allāhu Akbar, Allāhumma ahillahu `alayna bi 'l-amni wa 'l-īmān, was-salāmati wa 'l-'Islām, wat-tawfīqi limā tuḥibbu Rabbanā wa tarḍā, Rabbunā wa Rabbukallāh.
chapter_67.translation: Allah is the Most Great. O Allah, bring us the new moon with security and Faith, with peace and in Islam, and in harmony with what our Lord loves and what pleases Him. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.
chapter_67.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/504, Ad-Darimi 1/336. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/157.

chapter_68.dua_english: Dhahabaẓ-ẓama', wabtallati 'l-urūq, wa thabata 'l-'ajru in shā Allāh
chapter_68.dua_english_translation: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
chapter_68.dua_arabic: ذَهَـبَ الظَّمَـأُ، وَابْتَلَّـتِ العُـروق، وَثَبَـتَ الأجْـرُ إِنْ شـاءَ الله

chapter_68.dua_english: Allāhumma innī as'aluka bi raḥmatika 'l-latī wasi'at kulla shay' an taghfira lī
chapter_68.dua_english_translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which encompasses all things, that You forgive me.
chapter_68.dua_arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنَّـي أَسْـأَلُـكَ بِرَحْمَـتِكَ الّتي وَسِـعَت كُلَّ شيء، أَنْ تَغْـفِرَ لي
sources: Ibn Majah 1/557 from a supplication of Abdullah bin 'Amr
Al-Hafidh graded it as good in his checking of An-Nawawi's Kitabul-'Athkdr

chapter_69.title: Bismillah - Upon beginning to eat
chapter_69.transliteration: Bismillāh. And if you forget then when you remember, say: Bismillāhi fī awwalihi wa ākhirih.
chapter_69.english_translation: When anyone of you begins eating, say: With the Name of Allah. And if you forget then, when you remember, say: With the Name of Allah, in the beginning, and in the end.
chapter_69.arabic_text: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بسمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ

chapter_69.title: Dua for food and milk
chapter_69.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi, wa aṭ'imnā khayran minh. Whomever Allah has given milk to drink, should say: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi, wa zidnā minh.
chapter_69.english_translation: Whomever Allah has given food, should say: O Allah, bless us in it and provide us with better than it. Whomever Allah has given milk to drink, should say: O Allah, bless us in it and give us more of it.
chapter_69.arabic_text:
مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ: "اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ"،

وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَناً فَلْيَقُلْ "اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ"

chapter_70.title: Upon completing the meal - Hisn al-Muslim 180
chapter_70.arabic: الْحَمْـدُ للهِ الَّذي أَطْعَمَنـي هـذا وَرَزَقَنـيهِ مِنْ غَـيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلا قُوَّة
chapter_70.transliteration: Alhamdu lillāhi 'l-ladhī aṭ`amanī hādhā, wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī wa lā quwwah.
chapter_70.translation: Praise is to Allah Who has given me this food, and sustained me with it though I was unable to do it and powerless.
chapter_70.reference: At-Tirmidhi, Abu Dawud, and Ibn Majah. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/159.

chapter_70.title: Upon completing the meal - Hisn al-Muslim 181
chapter_70.arabic: الْحَمْـدُ للهِ حَمْـداً كَثـيراً طَيِّـباً مُبـارَكاً فيه، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلا مُسْتَغْـنىً عَنْـهُ رَبَّـنا
chapter_70.transliteration: Alhamdu lillāhi ḥamdan kathīran tayyiban mubārakan fīh, ghayra makfiyyin wa lā muwadda`in, wa lā mustaghnan `anhu Rabbanā.
chapter_70.translation: All praise is to Allah, praise in abundance, good and blessed. It cannot [be compensated for, nor can it] be left, nor can it be done without, our Lord.

chapter_71.title: Ayat al-Kursi
chapter_71.arabic_diacritic: اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
chapter_71.transliteration: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa 'l-Ḥayyul-Qayyūm, lā ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa lā nawm, lahu mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-ardh, man dhal-ladhī yashfa'u 'indahu illā bi'idhnih, ya'lamu mā bayna 'aydīhim wa mā khalfahum, wa lā yuḥītūna bishay'im-min 'ilmihi illā bimā shā'a, wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-ardh, wa lā ya'ūduhu hifẓuhumā, wa huwal-'Aliyyu 'l-'Aẓīm.
chapter_71.translation: Allah! There is none worthy of worship but He, the Ever-Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His Permission? He knows what happens to them in this world, and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never compass anything of His Knowledge except that which He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

reference.source: An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah (Hadith no. 100), also Ibn As-Sunni (no. 121). See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 5/339 and Silsilatul-Ahadith As-Sahihah 2/697 (no. 972).

chapter_72.title: Dua when intending to give food or drink
chapter_72.transliteration: Allāhumma aṭ'im man aṭ'amanī wasqi man saqānī.
chapter_72.english_translation: O Allah, feed the one who has fed me, and give drink to the one who has given me drink.
chapter_72.arabic_text: اللّهُـمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَن أَطْعَمَني، وَاسْقِ مَن سقاني

chapter_73.dua_english: With you, those who are fasting have broken their fast, you have fed those who are righteous, and the angels recite their prayers upon you.
chapter_73.dua_transliteration: Afṭara \`indakumuṣ-ṣā'imūn, wa akala ṭa\'āmakumu 'l-'abrār, wa ṣallat \`alaykumu 'l-malā'ikah.
chapter_73.dua_arabic: أَفْطَـرَ عِنْدَكُم الصّـائِمونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعامَـكُمُ الأبْـرار، وَصَلَّـتْ عَلَـيْكُمُ الملائِكَـة
chapter_73.reference: Abu Dawud 3/367, Ibn Majah 1/556, An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah 296-8. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 2/730.
chapter_73.occasion: When breaking fast in someone's home

chapter_74.english_text: When you are invited (to eat) then reply to the invitation. If you are fasting then invoke Allah's blessings (on your host), and if you are not fasting then eat.
chapter_74.transliteration: Idhā du'iya aḥadukum falya'ib, fa'in kāna ṣā'iman falya'salii, wa'in kāna mufṭiran falya'ṭa'am
chapter_74.arabic_text: إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُجِبْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ صَائِماً فَلْيُصَلِّ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُفْطِراً فَلْيَطْعَمْ
chapter_74.note: When you are invited (to eat) then reply to the invitation. If you are fasting then invoke Allah's blessings (on your host), and if you are not fasting then eat. The meaning of 'invoke Allah's blessings' (falya'salli) is to make supplication/dua (falya'da'u).

chapter_75.title: When insulted while fasting - Hisn al-Muslim 186
chapter_75.translation: I am fasting. I am fasting.

chapter_76.transliteration: Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm. Qul huwallāhu aḥad. Allāhuṣ-ṣamad. Lam yalid wa lam yūlad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad.
chapter_76.translation: With the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: He is Allah (the) One. The Self-Sufficient Master, Whom all creatures need, He begets not nor was He begotten, and there is none equal to Him.
chapter_76.arabic: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم { قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ * اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ * لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ * لَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ }

chapter_76.transliteration: Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm. Qul a'ūdhu birabbil-falaq. Min sharri mā khalaq. Wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffāthāti fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad.
chapter_76.translation: With the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: I seek refuge with (Allah) the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, and from the evil of the darkening (night) as it comes with its darkness, and from the evil of those who practice witchcraft when they blow in the knots, and from the evil of the envier when he envies.
chapter_76.arabic: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم { قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ * مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ * وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ * وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ * وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ }

chapter_76.transliteration: Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm. Qul a'ūdhu birabbin-nās. Malikin-nās. 'Ilāhin-nās. Min sharri 'l-waswāsil-khannās. Alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūrin-nās. Minal-jinnati wannās.
chapter_76.translation: With the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: I seek refuge with (Allah) the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, who whispers in the breasts of mankind, of jinns and men.
chapter_76.arabic: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم { قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ * مَلِكِ النَّاسِ * إِلَهِ النَّاسِ * مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ * الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ * مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ }

chapter_77.translation: All praises and thanks are to Allah.

companion_response.translation: May Allah have mercy upon you.

your_response.instruction: When someone says Yarḥamukallāh to you then you should say:
your_response.translation: May Allah guide you and set your affairs in order.

chapter_78.dua_english: May Allah guide you and set your affairs in order
chapter_78.reference_text: Reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/82, Ahmad 4/400, Abu Dawud 4/308. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/354.

chapter_79.title: To the newlywed - Hisn al-Muslim 190
chapter_79.arabic: بارَكَ اللّهُ لَك، وَبارَكَ عَلَـيْك، وَجَمَعَ بَيْـنَكُما في خَـيْر
chapter_79.transliteration: Bārakallāhu lak, wa bāraka `alayk, wa jama`a baynakumā fī khayr
chapter_79.translation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.
chapter_79.reference: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah and At-Tirmidhi. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 1/316

chapter_80.occasion: When marrying a woman or purchasing a servant
chapter_80.dua_english: When any of you marries a woman or purchases a maid-servant then let him say: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of her, and the goodness upon which You have created her, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of her, and from the evil upon which You have created her. If you purchase a camel then take hold of the top of its hump and say the same.
chapter_80.dua_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
chapter_80.dua_transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā wa khayra mā jabaltahā 'alayh, wa a'ūdhu bika min sharrihā wa sharri mā jabaltahā 'alayh

chapter_81.transliteration: Allāhumma mā aṣbaha bī min ni`matin aw bi aḥadin min khalqik, fa minka waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, falaka 'l-ḥamdu wa lakash-shukr.
chapter_81.english_translation: O Allah, whatever blessing has been received by me or anyone of Your creation is from You alone, You have no partner. All praise is for you and thanks is to You.
chapter_81.arabic_text: اللّهُـمَّ ما أَصْبَـَحَ بي مِـنْ نِعْـمَةٍ أَو بِأَحَـدٍ مِـنْ خَلْـقِك ، فَمِـنْكَ وَحْـدَكَ لا شريكَ لَـك ، فَلَـكَ الْحَمْـدُ وَلَـكَ الشُّكْـر
chapter_81.notes: When you say this in the evening, you should say: 'Allāhumma mā 'amsā bī...': 'O Allah, as I enter this evening...'. Whoever recites this in the morning, has completed his obligation to thank Allah for that day; and whoever says it in the evening, has completed his obligation for that night.
chapter_81.chain_of_transmission: Abu Dawud 4/318, An-Nasa'i 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 7), Ibn As-Sunni (no. 41), Ibn Hibban (no. 2361). Its chain of transmission is good (Hasan), Ibn Baz, p. 24.

chapter_82.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في بَدَنـي، اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في سَمْـعي، اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في بَصَـري، لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّه أَنْـتَ. اللّهُـمَّ إِنّـي أَعـوذُبِكَ مِنَ الْكُـفر، وَالفَـقْر، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذابِ القَـبْر، لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْـتَ. (ثلاث مرات)
chapter_82.transliteration: Allāhumma \'āfinī fī badanī, Allāhumma \'āfinī fī sam\'ī, Allāhumma \'āfinī fī baṣarī, lā ilāha illā ant. Allāhumma innī a\'ūdhu bika mina 'l-kufri, wa 'l-faqr, wa a\'ūdhu bika min \'adhābi 'l-qabr, lā ilāha illā ant. (Recite three times in Arabic.)
chapter_82.translation: O Allah, make me healthy in my body. O Allah, preserve for me my hearing. O Allah, preserve for me my sight. There is none worthy of worship but You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is none worthy of worship but You (Recite three times in Arabic.)
chapter_82.chain: Its chain of transmission is good (Hasan), Ibn Baz, p. 26.

chapter_83.transliteration: Alhamdu lillāhi 'l-ladhī `āfānī mimmab-talāka bihi wa faḍḍalanī `alā kathīrin mimman khalaqa tafḍīlā.
chapter_83.translation: Praise is to Allah Who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and preferred me greatly above much of what He has created.
chapter_83.arabic: الْحَمْـدُ للهِ الّذي عافاني مِمّا ابْتَـلاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَـني عَلى كَثيـرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَـقَ تَفْضـيلا
chapter_83.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/493,4. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/153.

chapter_84.english_text: Ibn Umar (ra) said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to repeat in a single sitting: My Lord, forgive me, and accept my repentance, You are the Ever-Relenting, the All-Forgiving.
chapter_84.transliteration: Rabbigh'fir lī wa tub `alayy innaka antat-Tawwābu 'l-Ghafūr
chapter_84.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الْغَفُورُ
chapter_84.narration: Ibn Umar (ra) said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to repeat in a single sitting:
chapter_84.note: He would repeat this supplication 100 times in a single sitting before standing up.
chapter_84.reference: Sahih Ibn Majah 2/321. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/153.

chapter_85.arabic_text: سُبْحـانَكَ اللّهُـمَّ وَبِحَمدِك، أَشْهَـدُ أَنْ لا إِلهَ إِلاّ أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَـيْك
chapter_85.transliteration: Subhānaka Allāhumma wa biḥamdik, ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā ant, astaghfiruka wa atību ilayk.
chapter_85.english_translation: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise is to You. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
chapter_85.reference: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, At-Tirmidhi and An-Nasa'i. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/153.
chapter_85.additional_information: Aishah (RA) said: 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not sit in a gathering, and did not recite the Qur'an, and did not perform any prayer without concluding by saying ... (then she quoted the above).' This was reported by An-Nasa'i in 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah (no.308), and Dr. Farooq Hamadah graded it authentic in his checking of the same book, p. 273. See also Ahmad 6/77

chapter_86.title: Returning a supplication of forgiveness - Hisn al-Muslim 197
chapter_86.reference: Ahmad 5/82, and An-Nasa'i in 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah p. 218, with checking by Dr. Farooq Hamadah.

chapter_87.category_name: To one who does you a favour
chapter_87.title: To one who does you a favour - Hisn al-Muslim 198
chapter_87.translation: May Allah reward you with good.
chapter_87.reference: At-Tirmidhi (no. 2035). See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/200 and Sahihul-Jami' (no. 6244).
tags: To one who does you a favour

chapter_88.category_name: Seeking Help and Refuge in Allah
chapter_88.title: Seeking Help and Refuge in Allah - Hisn al-Muslim 88
chapter_88.arabic: يا حَـيُّ يا قَيّـومُ بِـرَحْمَـتِكِ أَسْتَـغـيث ، أَصْلِـحْ لي شَـأْنـي كُلَّـه ، وَلا تَكِلـني إِلى نَفْـسي طَـرْفَةَ عَـين
chapter_88.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyumu birahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullah, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn.
chapter_88.translation: O Ever-Living One, O Eternal One, by Your mercy I call on You to set right all my affairs. Do not place me in charge of my soul even for the blinking of an eye.

chapter_89.dua_english: May He for Whose sake you love me, love you
chapter_89.reference: Abu Dawud 4/333. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 3/965
chapter_89.context: A supplication to make for someone who has expressed their love for you for the sake of Allah

chapter_90.category_name: To one who has offered you some of his wealth
chapter_90.title: Dua for one who offers their wealth - Hisn al-Muslim 201
chapter_90.arabic: بارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ في أَهْلِكَ وَمالِك
chapter_90.transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik.
chapter_90.translation: May Allah bless you in your family and your property.

chapter_91.text: Bārakallāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik, innamā jazā'us-salafi 'l-ḥamdu wa'l-adā'.
chapter_91.text_arabic: بارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ في أَهْلِكَ وَمالِك، إِنَّما جَـزاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ والأَداء
chapter_91.translation: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth, surely the reward for a loan is praise and returning (what was borrowed).
chapter_91.source_reference: See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/55

chapter_92.title: For fear of shirk - Hisn al-Muslim 92
chapter_92.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنّـي أَعـوذُبِكَ أَنْ أُشْـرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنا أَعْـلَمْ، وَأَسْتَـغْفِرُكَ لِما لا أَعْـلَم
chapter_92.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a`ūdhu bika an ushrika bika wa anā a`lam, wa astaghfiruka limā lā a`lam.
chapter_92.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I associate anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I know not.
chapter_92.reference: Ahmad 4/403. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 3/233 and Sahihut-Targhib wat-Tarhib 1/19.

chapter_93.title: Upon Rising in the Morning - Hisn al-Muslim 93
chapter_93.arabic: لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ وحْـدَهُ لا شَـريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُـلْكُ ولهُ الحَمْـد، وهُوَ على كُلّ شَيءٍ قَدير
chapter_93.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
chapter_93.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise and He is Able to do all things.
chapter_93.reference: Al-Bukhari 4/95, Muslim 4/2071. Recite 100 times upon rising in the morning.

chapter_94.transliteration: Allāhumma lā ṭayra illā ṭayruk, wa lā khayra illā khayruk, wa lā ilāha ghayruk.
chapter_94.translation: O Allah there is no portent other than Your portent, no goodness other than Your goodness, and none worthy of worship other than You.
chapter_94.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ لا طَيْـرَ إِلاّ طَيْـرُك، وَلا خَـيْرَ إِلاّ خَـيْرُك، وَلا إِلهَ غَيْـرُك
chapter_94.chain: Ahmad 2/220, Ibn As-Sunni (no. 292). See also Al-Albani, Silsilatul-'Ahadlth As-Sahihah 3/54, (no. 1065)
chapter_94.notes: As for bodings of good, these used to please the Prophet (ﷺ) and so when he heard good words from someone, he used to say: 'We have taken from you a good portent from your mouth,' Abu Dawud, Ahmad. See also Al-Albani, Silsilatul-'Ahadith As-Sahihah 2/363, and it is with Abu Ash-Shaikh Al-Asfahani in 'Akhlaqun-Nabiyy, pg. 270.

chapter_95.transliteration: Bismillāh, walḥamdulillāh. Subḥāna 'lladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn. Wa innā ilā Rabbinā lamunqalibūn. Alḥamdulillāh, alḥamdulillāh, alḥamdulillāh, Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Subḥānaka 'llāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī, faghfir lī, fa innahu lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant.
chapter_95.arabic: بِسْـمِ اللهِ وَالْحَمْـدُ لله، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ الحَمْـدُ لله، الحَمْـدُ لله، الحَمْـدُ لله، اللهُ أكْـبَر، اللهُ أكْـبَر، اللهُ أكْـبَر، سُـبْحانَكَ اللّهُـمَّ إِنّي ظَلَـمْتُ نَفْسي فَاغْـفِرْ لي، فَإِنَّهُ لا يَغْفِـرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاّ أَنْـت
chapter_95.english_translation: With the Name of Allah. Praise is to Allah. Glory is to Him Who has provided this for us though we could never have had it by our efforts. Surely, unto our Lord, we are returning. Praise is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Glory is to You. O Allah, I have wronged my own soul. Forgive me, for surely none forgives sins but You.
chapter_95.reference: Abu Dawud 3/34, At-Tirmidhi 5/501. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/156.

chapter_96.translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and repent to Him
chapter_96.instruction: Recite one hundred times in Arabic during the day

chapter_97.arabic: أللّـهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّـمواتِ السّـبْعِ وَما أَظْلَلَـن، وَرَبَّ الأَراضيـنَ السّـبْعِ وَما أقْلَلْـن، وَرَبَّ الشَّيـاطينِ وَما أَضْلَلْـن، وَرَبَّ الرِّياحِ وَما ذَرَيْـن، أَسْـأَلُـكَ خَيْـرَ هذهِ الْقَـرْيَةِ وَخَيْـرَ أَهْلِـها، وَخَيْـرَ ما فيها، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّها وَشَـرِّ أَهْلِـها، وَشَـرِّ ما فيها
chapter_97.transliteration: Allāhumma Rabbas-samāwātis-sab\'i wa mā aẓlaln, Wa Rabba 'l-arāḍīnas-sab\'i wa mā aqlaln, wa Rabbash-shayāṭīni wa mā aḍlaln, wa Rabbar-riyāḥi wa mā dharayn. As'aluka khayra hādhihi 'l-qaryah, wa khayra ahlihā, wa khayra māfīhā, wa a\'ūdhu bika min sharrihā, wa sharri ahlihā, wa sharri mā fīhā.
chapter_97.english: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they overshadow, Lord of the seven worlds and all they uphold, Lord of the devils and all they lead astray, Lord of the winds and all they scatter. I ask You for the goodness of this town, and for the goodness of its people, and for the goodness it contains. I seek refuge in You from its evil, from the evil of its people, and from the evil it contains.
chapter_97.reference_details: Al-Hakim who graded it authentic and Ath-Tfaahabi agreed 2/100, and Ibn As-Sunni (no. 524). Al-Hafidh graded it good in his checking of Al-'Athkdr 5/154. Ibn Baz said in Tuhfatul-'Akhydr p. 37, that An-Nasa'i recorded it with a good chain of narration.

chapter_98.dua_arabic: لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّه وحدَهُ لا شريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلْـكُ ولهُ الحَمْـد، يُحْيـي وَيُميـتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لا يَمـوت، بِيَـدِهِ الْخَـيْرُ وَهوَ على كلّ شيءٍ قدير
chapter_98.dua_english: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He brings life and He causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His Hand is all good, and He is Able to do all things.
chapter_98.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāh waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, Lahu 'l-mulku wa lahu 'l-ḥamd, Yuḥyī wa yumīt, wa huwa ḥayyun lā yamūt, Biyadihi 'l-khayr, wa huwa `alā kulli shay'in Qadīr.
chapter_98.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/291, and Al-Hakim 1/538. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Ibn Majah 2/21 and Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/152.

chapter_99.authenticity: Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 3/941

chapter_100.translation: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.
chapter_100.arabic: أَسْتَـوْدِعُكُـمُ اللَّهَ الَّـذي لا تَضـيعُ وَدائِعُـه
chapter_100.reference: Ahmad 2/403, Ibn Majah 2/943. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/133.

chapter_101.transliteration: Astawdi`ullāha dīnak, wa amānatak, wa khawātīma `amalik.
chapter_101.translation: I leave your religion in the care of Allah, as well as your safety, and the last of your deeds.
chapter_101.arabic: أَسْتَـوْدِعُ اللَّهَ ديـنَكَ وَأَمانَتَـكَ، وَخَـواتيـمَ عَمَـلِك
chapter_101.source_reference: Ahmad 2/7, At-Tirmidhi 5/499. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/155.

chapter_101.transliteration: Zawwadaka 'llāhut-taqwā, wa ghafara dhanbak, wa yassara laka 'l-khayra ḥaythu mā kunt.
chapter_101.translation: May Allah give you piety as your provision, forgive your sins, and make goodness easy for you wherever you are.
chapter_101.arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التقْوى، وَغَفَـرَذَنْـبَكَ، وَيَسَّـرَ لَكَ الخَـيْرَ حَيْـثُما كُنْـت

chapter_102.title: When laying down to sleep - Hisn al-Muslim 102
chapter_102.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
chapter_102.transliteration: Bismika Rabbī waḍa'tu janbī, wa bika arfa'uh, fa in amsakta nafsī farḥamhā, wa in arsaltahā faḥfaẓhā bimā taḥfaẓu bihi 'ibādakaṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
chapter_102.translation: With Your Name my Lord, I lay myself down; and with Your Name I rise. And if You take my soul, have mercy on it, and if You send it back then protect it as You protect Your righteous slaves.
chapter_102.reference: If any of you rises from his bed and later returns to it, let him dust off his bed with his waist garment three times and mention the Name of Allah, for he does not know what may have entered the bed after him, and when he lies down he should say this dua. Al-Bukhari 11/126 and Muslim 4/2084.

chapter_103.title: Before Lying Down to Sleep - Hisn al-Muslim 103
chapter_103.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْياهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ
chapter_103.transliteration: Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsi wa anta tawaffahha, laka mamatuha wa mahyaha, in ahyaytaha fahfazha, wa in amattaha faghfir laha. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afiyah.
chapter_103.translation: O Allah, You have created my soul and You take it back. Unto You is its death and its life. If You give it life then protect it, and if You cause it to die then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for strength.

chapter_104.title: Before sleeping - Hisn al-Muslim 104
chapter_104.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ قِنـي عَذابَـكَ يَـوْمَ تَبْـعَثُ عِبـادَك
chapter_104.translation: O Allah, save me from Your punishment on the Day that You resurrect Your slaves.
chapter_104.reference: Abu Dawud 4/311. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/143.

chapter_105.english_translation: In Your Name, O Allah, I die and I live.

reference.note: Here, dying and living are metaphors for sleep and wakefulness. This explains why the normal order of these words has been reversed in this Hadith. In other contexts the living is mentioned before dying. See Qur'an Al-Baqarah 2:258, Aal-'Imran 3:156, Al-A'raf 7:158 among many other examples.

chapter_105.context: This dua is recited upon waking up from sleep

chapter_106.category_name: What to say upon receiving pleasing or displeasing news
chapter_106.title: When receiving something that pleases you - Hisn al-Muslim 218
chapter_106.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
chapter_106.translation: Praise is to Allah Who by His blessings all good things are perfected.
chapter_106.description: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say this supplication.
chapter_106.reference: Ibn As-Sunni, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah, and Al-Hakim who graded it authentic 1/499. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 4/201.

chapter_106.category_name: What to say upon receiving pleasing or displeasing news
chapter_106.title: When receiving something that displeases you - Hisn al-Muslim 218
chapter_106.translation: Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.
chapter_106.description: When something happened that displeased him, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say this supplication.
chapter_106.reference: Ibn As-Sunni, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah, and Al-Hakim who graded it authentic 1/499. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 4/201.

chapter_107.english: Whoever prays for Allah's blessings upon me once, will be blessed for it by Allah ten times.
chapter_107.arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْراً

chapter_107.source: Abu Dawud 2/218, Ahmad 2/367. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 2/383
chapter_107.english: Do not make my grave a place of ritual celebration, but pray for Allah's blessings upon me, for your blessings reach me from wherever you are.
chapter_107.arabic: لاَ تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيداً وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ؛ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُم تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ

chapter_107.source: At-Tirmidhi 5/551 and others. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/177 and Sahihul-Jarai' As-Saghir 3/25
chapter_107.english: The miser is the one in whose presence I am mentioned yet does not pray for Allah's blessings upon me.
chapter_107.arabic: الْبَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ

chapter_107.source: An-Nasa'i, Al-Hakim 2/421. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih An-Nasa'i 1/274
chapter_107.english: Indeed Allah has angels who roam the earth and they convey to me the greetings (or prayers of peace) of my Ummah (nation).
chapter_107.arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلاَئِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلاَمَ

chapter_107.source: Abu Dawud (no. 2041). Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/383
chapter_107.english: No one sends greetings (or prayers of peace) upon me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greetings.
chapter_107.arabic: مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلاَّ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِيَ حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ

chapter_108.title: After eating - Hisn al-Muslim 108
chapter_108.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ
chapter_108.transliteration: Alḥamdu lillāhil-lathī 'aṭ`amanā wa saqānā, wa kafānā, wa 'āwānā, fakam mimman lā kāfiya lahu wa lā mu'wī.
chapter_108.translation: Praise is to Allah Who has provided us with food and with drink, sufficed us and gave us an abode, for how many are there with no provision and no home.

chapter_109.english: If one of the People of the Scripture (i.e. Christians and Jews) greets you, saying As-Salāmu alaykum, then say (to him): And upon you.
chapter_109.arabic: إذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا: وَعَلَيْكُمْ

chapter_110.category_name: Upon hearing a rooster crow or the braying of a donkey
chapter_110.title: Upon hearing a rooster crow or the braying of a donkey - Hisn al-Muslim 228
chapter_110.arabic: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ؛ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكاً وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَاناً
chapter_110.transliteration: When you hear the cock's crow, ask Allah for His favor upon you for surely it has seen an angel. When you hear the bray of a donkey, seek refuge in Allah from Satan, for surely it has seen a devil.
chapter_110.translation: When you hear the cock's crow, ask Allah for His favor upon you for surely it has seen an angel. When you hear the bray of a donkey, seek refuge in Allah from Satan, for surely it has seen a devil.
tags: Upon hearing a rooster crow or the braying of a donkey

chapter_111.title: Before sleeping - Submission to Allah - Hisn al-Muslim 111
chapter_111.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ أَسْـلَمْتُ نَفْـسي إِلَـيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْـتُ أَمْـري إِلَـيْكَ، وَوَجَّـهْتُ وَجْـهي إِلَـيْكَ، وَأَلْـجَـاْتُ ظَهـري إِلَـيْكَ، رَغْبَـةً وَرَهْـبَةً إِلَـيْكَ، لا مَلْجَـأَ وَلا مَنْـجـا مِنْـكَ إِلاّ إِلَـيْكَ، آمَنْـتُ بِكِتـابِكَ الّـذي أَنْزَلْـتَ وَبِنَبِـيِّـكَ الّـذي أَرْسَلْـت
chapter_111.transliteration: Allāhumma aslamtu nafsī ilayk, wa fawwaḍtu amrī ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhī ilayk, wa alja'tu ẓahrī ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, lā malja'a wa la manjā minka illā ilayk, āmantu bikitābika 'l-ladhī anzalt, wa bi-nabiyyika 'l-ladhī arsalt.
chapter_111.translation: O Allah, I submit myself to You, entrust my affairs to You, turn my face to You, and lay myself down depending upon You, hoping in You and fearing You. There is no refuge, and no escape, except to You. I believe in Your Book (the Qur'an) that You revealed, and the Prophet whom You sent.
chapter_111.reference: Before you go to bed perform ablutions as you would for prayer, then lie down on your right side and say this dua. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Whoever says this and dies in his sleep, has died in a state of the natural monotheism (Fitrah). Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 11/113; Muslim 4/2081.

chapter_112.category_name: When tossing and turning during the night
chapter_112.title: When tossing and turning during the night - Hisn al-Muslim 112
chapter_112.arabic: لا إِلـهَ إِلاّ اللهُ الـواحِدُ القَهّـار رَبُّ السَّـمواتِ وَالأرْضِ وَما بَيْـنَهـما العَزيـزُ الغَـفّار
chapter_112.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāh al-Wāḥidul-Qahhār, Rabbus-samāwāti wa 'l-arḍi wa mā baynahuma al-`Azīzul-Ghaffār.
chapter_112.translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, the One, the Victorious, Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the All-Mighty, the All-Forgiving.
chapter_112.reference: This is to be said if you turn over in bed during the night. Al-Hakim graded it authentic and Ath-Thahabi agreed 1/540. Also see An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah, and Ibn As-Sunni. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 4/ 213.

chapter_113.category_name: Etiquette of praising a fellow Muslim
chapter_113.title: What to say when praising a fellow Muslim - Hisn al-Muslim 231
chapter_113.arabic: إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُم مَادِحاً صَاحِبَهُ لاَ مَحَالَةَ فَلْيَقُلْ: أَحْسِبُ فُلاَناً وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلاَ أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَداً، أَحْسِبُهُ – إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ – كَذَا وَكَذَا
chapter_113.transliteration: Aḥsibu fulānan wallāhu ḥasībuh wa lā uzakkī `alallāhi aḥada.
chapter_113.translation: If any of you praises his companion then let him say: I consider (such and such a person), and Allah is his Assessor, (meaning: and I cannot claim anyone to be pious before Allah) if you know of this (good character trait in the person) to be such and such (saying what he thinks is praiseworthy in that person).
chapter_113.explanation: If any of you praises his companion then let him say:

chapter_114.transliteration: Allāhumma lā tu'ākhidhnī bimā yaqūlūn, waghfir lī mā lā yaĀlamūn wa jāġalnī khayran mimmā yaẓunnūn.
chapter_114.translation: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of and make me better than they imagine.
chapter_114.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْرًا مِمَّا يَظُّنُّونَ
chapter_114.reference: Al-Bukhari, Al-'Adabul-Mufrad no. 761. See Al-Albani, Sahih Al-'Adabul-Mufrad (no. 585). The portion with 'make me better' is from Al-Bayhaqi, Shu'ab Al-Iman 4/228.

chapter_115.text_en: Get up and pray if you desire to do so.

chapter_116.title: Qunoot of the Witr Prayer - Hisn al-Muslim 116
chapter_116.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ اهْـدِنـي فـيمَنْ هَـدَيْـت، وَعـافِنـي فـيمَنْ عافَـيْت، وَتَوَلَّـني فـيمَنْ تَوَلَّـيْت، وَبارِكْ لـي فـيما أَعْطَـيْت، وَقِـني شَرَّ ما قَضَـيْت، فَإِنَّـكَ تَقْـضي وَلا يُقْـضى عَلَـيْك ، إِنَّـهُ لا يَـذِلُّ مَنْ والَـيْت، وَلا يَعِـزُّ مَن عـادَيْت، تَبـارَكْـتَ رَبَّـنا وَتَعـالَـيْت
chapter_116.transliteration: Allāhumma'hdinī fī man hadayt, wa 'āfinī fī man 'āfayt, wa tawallanī fī man tawallayt, wa bārik lī fī mā a'atayt, wa qinī sharra mā qaḍayt, fa innaka taqḍī wa lā yuqḍā 'alayk, innahu lā yadhillu man wālayt, wa lā ya'izzu man 'ādayt, tabārakta Rabbanā wa ta'ālayt.
chapter_116.translation: O Allah, guide me with those whom You have guided, and strengthen me with those whom You have given strength. Take me to Your care with those whom You have taken to Your care. Bless me in what You have given me. Protect me from the evil You have ordained. Surely, You command and are not commanded, and none whom You have committed to Your care shall be humiliated and none whom You have taken as an enemy shall taste glory. You are Blessed, Our Lord, and Exalted.
chapter_116.reference: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, An-Nasa'i, At-Tirmidhi, Ahmad, Ad-Darimi, Al-Hakim, and Al-Bayhaqi. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 1/144, Sahih Ibn Majah 1/194, and 'Irwa'ul-Ghalil 2/172.

chapter_117.title: Supplication between Yemeni Corner and Black Stone
chapter_117.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanah wa fi 'l-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā `adhāban-nār
chapter_117.translation: Our Lord, grant us the good things in this world, and the good things in the next life, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.
chapter_117.arabic: ﴿رَبَّنَا آتِنَا في الدُّنْيَا حسَنَةً وفي الآخِرَةِ حسَنةً وقِنَا عذَابَ النَّارِ﴾
chapter_117.grading: Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/354
chapter_117.additional_notes: The Ayat is from Surat Al-Baqarah, 2:201

chapter_118.transliteration: Allāhumma iyyāka na`bud, wa laka nuṣallī wa nasjud, wa ilayka nas`ā wa naḥfid, narjū raḥmatak, wa nakhshā `adhābak, inna `adhābaka bilkāfirīna mulḥaq. Allāhumma innā nasta`īnuk, wa nastaghfiruk, wa nuthnī `alaykal-khayr, wa lā nakfuruk, wa nu'minu bik, wa nakhḍa`u lak, wa nakhla`u man yakfuruk.
chapter_118.translation: O Allah, You alone do we worship, and to You we pray and bow down prostrate. To You we hasten to worship and to serve. Our hope is for Your mercy, and we fear Your punishment. Surely, Your punishment of the disbelievers is at hand. O Allah, we seek Your help and Your forgiveness, and we praise You beneficently. We do not deny You and we believe in You. We surrender to You and renounce whoever disbelieves in You.
chapter_118.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِيّـاكَ نعْـبُدْ، وَلَـكَ نُصَلّـي وَنَسْـجُد، وَإِلَـيْكَ نَسْـعى وَنَحْـفِد، نَـرْجو رَحْمَـتَك، وَنَخْشـى عَـذابَك، إِنَّ عَـذابَكَ بالكـافرين ملْحَـق. اللّهُـمَّ إِنّا نَسْتَعـينُكَ وَنَسْتَـغْفِرُك، وَنُثْـنـي عَلَـيْك الخَـيْرَ، وَلا نَكْـفُرُك، وَنُـؤْمِنُ بِك، وَنَخْـضَعُ لَكَ وَنَخْـلَعُ مَنْ يَكْـفرُك
chapter_118.reference: Al-Bayhaqi graded its chain authentic in As-Sunan Al-Kubra. Al-Albani said in 'Irwa'ul-GhaliL 2/170 that its chain is authentic as a statement of 'Umar.

chapter_119.category_name: Remembrance immediately after salam of the witr prayer
chapter_119.title: Remembrance immediately after salam of the witr prayer - Hisn al-Muslim 119
chapter_119.arabic: سبحان الملك القدوس ثلاث مرات والثالثة يجهر بها ويمد بها صوته ربِّ الملائكةِ والرّوح
chapter_119.transliteration: Subḥāna 'l-Maliki 'l-Quddūs. [Recite three times, and raise and extend the voice on the third time and say...] Rabbi 'l-Malā'ikati war-rūh.
